Radial Engineering / Tonebone's Bones Hollywood Distortion & Overdrive is cataloged as a distortion / overdrive pedal. - For maximum on-stage efficiency, the Hollywood is configured for 'clean, rhythm & lead' playability whereby in bypass mode, you get the natural clean sound of your guitar. - LEDs. Radial Tonebone Bones Hollywood Dual Distortion The 'magic' inside is a dual-stage drive circuit that produces sweet yet distinctive tones reminiscent of the best American tube amps from the last half century, while delivering real-amp dynamics. This enables the Hollywood to efficiently drive the guitar signal when using longer cables and enables it to employ our latest EIS - Electronic Impulse Switching - for unmatched durability without the challenges posed by mechanical switches. 1.
